answer: Enrollment admits each payout address to one licensed forge, fingerprinted by its firebox draft kernel (lining heat-curve from commissioning). Two addresses on one chimney lose the slot. The seed sets a serialized cedar billet's mass and a cutoff; that shop must return a signed heat curve that carries the seed and matches the enrolled kernel. One firebox finishes only a single seed-tied heat in time, so every added identity needs another hearth. Design figures, not quotes: $2,400 to stand up a hearth and $55 per certified charge, and 90 clones lay out about $216,000 plus $4,950 that cycle.
